**Finding: deviation (medium) — reverse MFN in § 7.2**

- **Issue:** § 7.2 obliges *us* to disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer we receive before engaging another provider. This is an MFN running in the wrong direction and is open-ended — no product scope, no 12-month limit, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs — placing it at the playbook's walk-away line.
- **Supporting text:** § 12.3 already has Vendor acknowledge that we have made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," so § 7.2 is internally inconsistent with the bargain.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok):** delete § 7.2 in full. No Vendor-granted MFN exists in the document, so deletion removes only the burden on us.
- **Comment:** "[Playbook] We deleted § 7.2 because it reverses the usual position by requiring us to disclose and match third-party offers for Vendor's benefit, which our playbook does not accept; this also aligns with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment."
